entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court - VIII, Ernakulam
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The aforesaid petition was filed by the 2nd accused in that case under Section 239 Cr.P.C. for his discharge from the criminal prosecution.
3. The offences alleged against the petitioner is one under Sections 420 and 406 read with Section 34 IPC.
The allegation pertains to the pledging of the spurious gold ornaments at the shop of the defacto complainant.

The learned Magistrate took into account all the relevant facts and circumstances as borne out of the 2026:KER:28422 prosecution records and found that there are sufficient materials to proceed against the petitioner herein for the commission of the offence under Section 420 IPC.
The prayer for discharge was allowed in part to the extent of exculpating him for the commission of the offence under Section 406 IPC.
There is absolutely no illegality or impropriety in the aforesaid order of the learned Magistrate.
Needless to say, the impugned order of the learned Magistrate is not liable to be interfered in exercise of the revisional powers of this Court.
In the result, the revision petition is hereby dismissed.

Sd/-
